items.exampleEn: Low prices coupled with friendly service keep customers coming back.
items.exampleZh: 低廉的價格加上親切的服務，讓顧客一再上門。

items.exampleEn: Her gushing praise made the shy student blush.
items.exampleZh: 她過分熱情的讚美讓那個害羞的學生臉紅了。

items.exampleEn: The shelves are firmly anchored to the wall.
items.exampleZh: 架子牢牢地固定在牆上。

items.exampleEn: She spoke gushingly about her new boss.
items.exampleZh: 她滔滔不絕、熱情過頭地談論她的新老闆。
items.glossZh: 過分熱情地；滔滔不絕地

items.exampleEn: The children reenacted their favorite scene from the movie.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們把電影裡最喜歡的一幕重新演了一遍。

items.exampleEn: Wash the suds off the dishes before you dry them.
items.exampleZh: 擦乾碗盤之前，先把上面的泡沫沖掉。

items.exampleEn: Many students turn to online videos when they don't understand a lesson.
items.exampleZh: 很多學生聽不懂課的時候，會求助於網路影片。
items.glossZh: 求助於；轉而（做）；翻到（某頁）

items.sentenceEn: Make sure the tent is properly anchored before the wind picks up.
items.sentenceZh: 在風變大之前，確認帳篷已經固定好。

items.audioEn: My grandmother writes gushing thank-you letters for even the smallest gift.
items.audioZh: 就算是最小的禮物，我奶奶也會寫熱情洋溢的感謝信。
items.questionZh: 奶奶收到小禮物時會怎麼做？
options: She calls to say she doesn't need it.
She gives the gift to a friend instead.
She asks for a more useful present.
She writes a very warm letter.

items.sentenceEn: Every year, the museum reenacts a traditional wedding for visitors.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館每年都會為遊客重現一場傳統婚禮。

items.sentenceEn: The washing machine was full of suds because I used too much soap.
items.sentenceZh: 因為我放了太多洗衣精，洗衣機裡滿是泡沫。

items.stemEn: Long working hours, ____ with a long trip home, left him tired every evening.
items.stemZh: 工時很長，加上回家的路程又遠，讓他每天晚上都很累。

items.stemEn: The host thanked us so ____ that we felt a little embarrassed.
items.stemZh: 主人熱情過頭地向我們道謝，讓我們有點不好意思。

items.passageEn: Every October, the people of our small harbor town reenact the arrival of the first steam ship in 1890. Volunteers dress in old clothes and wait by the water, where a wooden boat, recently saved through careful restoration, stays anchored for the whole weekend. This year the weather was cold, and the wind, coupled with heavy rain, nearly ended the show. The organizers turned to the local fire station for help, and firefighters put up large tents in an hour. Afterwards, a visiting reporter wrote gushingly about the event. The children's favorite part, however, was washing the old boat on Sunday morning, with buckets of suds and gushing water from a long pipe.
items.passageZh: 每年十月，我們這個海港小鎮的居民都會重現 1890 年第一艘蒸汽船抵達的情景。志工們穿上舊式服裝在水邊等候，一艘最近經過細心修復而保留下來的木船，整個週末都停泊在那裡。今年天氣很冷，強風加上大雨，差點讓表演辦不下去。主辦單位向當地消防隊求助，消防員在一小時內就搭好了大帳篷。事後，一位來訪的記者熱情洋溢地報導了這場活動。不過，孩子們最喜歡的部分，是週日早上用一桶桶肥皂泡沫和從長水管湧出的水清洗那艘舊船。

questions.questionZh: 風雨差點讓活動停辦時，主辦單位怎麼做？
options: 把活動延到下一個週末舉行
請志工改到室內體育館表演

questions.questionZh: 孩子們最喜歡活動的哪個部分？
options: 穿上一百多年前的舊衣服
跟消防員一起搭大帳篷
在水邊看蒸汽船開進港

items.promptZh: 遇到問題的時候，她總是向姊姊求助。
referenceEn: When she has a problem, she always turns to her sister.
She always turns to her older sister for help when she has problems.
rubricZh: 「向⋯求助」用 turn to＋人，可再加 for help（例如 turns to her sister for help）
說的是習慣，時態配合內容（例如 turns、always turns）
「姊姊」可寫，例如 her sister、her older sister 等

items.promptZh: 她站在瀑布前，看著湧出的水。
referenceEn: She stood by the waterfall, watching the gushing water.
She stood in front of the waterfall and watched the gushing water.
rubricZh: 「湧出的」用 gushing（例如 the gushing water 等）
「站在瀑布前」可寫，例如 stood by the waterfall、stood in front of the waterfall 等
時態配合內容（例如 stood、watched 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確
